1: // Neon Runner with enhanced graphics
2: (() => {
3:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4:   if (!canvas) return; // no canvas present
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   // Enable crisp neon glow
7:   ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
8:   // Audio setup
9:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
10:   const playTone = (freq, duration) => {
11:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
12:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
13:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
14:     osc.type = 'sine';
15:     osc.connect(gain);
16:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
17:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
18:     osc.start();
19:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
20:   };
21:   const width = canvas.width;
22:   const height = canvas.height;
23: 
24:   // Player state
25:   const player = {
26:     w: 30,
27:     h: 30,
28:     x: width * 0.2,
29:     y: height - 30,
30:     vy: 0,
31:     jumpForce: -12,
32:     gravity: 0.6,
33:     sliding: false,
34:     slideTimer: 0,
35:     color: '#0ff',
36:   };
37: 
38:   // Obstacles
39:   const obstacles = [];
40:   let obstacleTimer = 0;
41:   const obstacleInterval = 90; // frames
42:   let speed = 4; // scroll speed (downwards)
43:   let frame = 0;
44:   let running = true;
45: 
46:   const spawnObstacle = () => {
47:     const w = 30 + Math.random() * 50;
48:     const h = 30 + Math.random() * 50;
49:     const x = Math.random() * (width - w);
50:     obstacles.push({ w, h, x, y: -h, speed: speed + Math.random() * 2 });
51:   };
52: 
53:   const rectCollide = (a, b) =>
54:     a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y;
55: 
56:   const handleInput = (e) => {
57:     if (e.code === 'Space' && player.y >= height - player.h) {
58:       player.vy = player.jumpForce; // jump
59:       playTone(440, 0.1); // jump sound
60:     } else if (e.code === 'ArrowDown' && !player.sliding && player.y >= height - player.h) {
61:       player.sliding = true;
62:       player.slideTimer = 15; // frames
63:       player.h = 15; // reduce height
64:       playTone(220, 0.1); // slide sound
65:     }
66:       player.sliding = true;
67:       player.slideTimer = 15; // frames
68:       player.h = 15; // reduce height
69:     }
70:   };
71: 
72:   document.addEventListener('keydown', handleInput);
73: 
74:   const update = () => {
75:     // player physics
76:     player.vy += player.gravity;
77:     player.y += player.vy;
78:     if (player.y > height - player.h) {
79:       player.y = height - player.h;
80:       player.vy = 0;
81:     }
82:     if (player.sliding) {
83:       player.slideTimer--;
84:       if (player.slideTimer <= 0) {
85:         player.sliding = false;
86:         player.h = 30; // restore height
87:       }
88:     }
89:     // obstacles
90:     obstacleTimer++;
91:     if (obstacleTimer >= obstacleInterval) {
92:       obstacleTimer = 0;
93:       spawnObstacle();
94:     }
95:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
96:       const obs = obstacles[i];
97:       obs.y += obs.speed;
98:       if (obs.y > height) obstacles.splice(i, 1);
99:     }
100:     // collision check
101:     for (const obs of obstacles) {
102:       if (rectCollide(player, obs)) {
103:         running = false;
104:         // collision sound
105:         playTone(100, 0.3);
106:         break;
107:       }
108:     }
109:     // increase difficulty
110:     if (frame % 600 === 0) speed += 0.5;
111:     frame++;
112:   };
113: 
114:   const draw = () => {
115:     // Background gradient
116:     const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, height);
117:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
118:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#004');
119:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
120:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
121: 
122:     // Neon glow settings
123:     ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
124:     ctx.shadowColor = '#0ff';
125: 
126:     // Player – neon rounded rectangle
127:     ctx.fillStyle = player.color;
128:     const radius = 6;
129:     ctx.beginPath();
130:     ctx.moveTo(player.x + radius, player.y);
131:     ctx.lineTo(player.x + player.w - radius, player.y);
132:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(player.x + player.w, player.y, player.x + player.w, player.y + radius);
133:     ctx.lineTo(player.x + player.w, player.y + player.h - radius);
134:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(player.x + player.w, player.y + player.h, player.x + player.w - radius, player.y + player.h);
135:     ctx.lineTo(player.x + radius, player.y + player.h);
136:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(player.x, player.y + player.h, player.x, player.y + player.h - radius);
137:     ctx.lineTo(player.x, player.y + radius);
138:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(player.x, player.y, player.x + radius, player.y);
139:     ctx.closePath();
140:     ctx.fill();
141: 
142:     // Obstacles – neon outlines
143:     ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
144:     ctx.shadowColor = '#f0f';
145:     ctx.strokeStyle = '#f0f';
146:     ctx.lineWidth = 3;
147:     for (const obs of obstacles) {
148:       ctx.strokeRect(obs.x, obs.y, obs.w, obs.h);
149:     }
150: 
151:     // Reset shadow for UI
152:     ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
153:   };
154: 
155:   const loop = () => {
156:     if (!running) {
157:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
158:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
159:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
160:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
161:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
162:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
163:       return;
164:     }
165:     update();
166:     draw();
167:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
168:   };
169: 
170:   // start loop after window loads to ensure canvas size
171:   if (document.readyState === 'complete') loop(); else window.addEventListener('load', loop);
172: })();

(End of file - total 172 lines)
